summary: Stop normalizing historical event files in place. The hardening transition checker byte-compares every pre-existing .swarm/events file and rejects any changed/deleted event. Current workers are repairing strict-schema validation failures by rewriting immutable events; even after the last event becomes schema-valid, the next transition-check will reject those rewrites. Recovery must preserve historical event bytes and make the trusted validator safely read legacy event shapes (or use another explicitly designed append-only migration mechanism). Do not edit/delete more existing events while this control recovery is active.
evidence: tools/swarm/swarmctl_hardening_base.py transition_check builds byte maps for events/*/*.json and raises ControlError when any common event bytes changed or an event was deleted.
Control push runs have sequentially rewritten existing events to satisfy validate_event; those changes cannot pass immutable-event transition checking once schema validation reaches that step.
Latest observed control run 31466983085 still fails strict event validation before transition-check, now on evt-20260811-062900-went7k3-pr283-review-request.json unknown key nextAction.
